data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 199.094m. During 2018 the syndicate experienced an adverse prior-year run-off of GBP 6.0m (strengthening), wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2016 year of account and the prior whole account quota share with Syndicate 2003. Management attributes deterioration in prior years mainly to natural catastrophe events (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California wildfires) which added to adverse development across property-dominated business and related classes.
raw_causal_phrases: An unfavorable run-off deviation (prior accident years' increase) of GBP 6.0m (2017: unfavorable of GBP 4.7m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2016 year of account and prior Whole Account Quota Share contract with Syndicate 2003.
The prior year development from natural catastrophes in the second half of 2017 such as Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria and California Wildfires added to the adverse performance for 2018.
The underwriting performance in 2018 was driven by the continuous softening of the rates across the portfolio in the market.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement sourced from note 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states an unfavourable run-off deviation of GBP 6.0m; the note is presented as a gross prior-year movement and has been used as such. No per-line-of-business prior-year movement amounts are disclosed. Gross claims development triangle is available (gross triangle on page 32) and is consistent with reserves, but the movement note is the primary source for prior-year development. Where amounts are not explicitly broken down by LOB they are left null.
